description: Classify a product into an HS (Harmonized System) code for customs using the v3.3 GRI pipeline. Supports 9-field input for maximum accuracy. material is REQUIRED for the v3.3 pipeline — without it, classification will fail with 400 error. Returns HS code, description, confidence, decision path, and GRI rules applied.

composition.description: Material composition with percentages. Example: '100% cotton', '70% polyester 30% cotton', '18/8 stainless steel'

description.description: Detailed product description for better accuracy. Example: 'Men's woven dress shirt with long sleeves and button front'

hsCode.description: Known HS code to override classification. Example: '6109.10'

material.description: Primary material — REQUIRED for v3.3 pipeline. Example: 'cotton', 'leather', 'steel', 'polyester', 'rubber', 'wood', 'glass'

price.description: Unit price in USD. Used for price-break HS rules (e.g. 'valued over $X'). Example: 49.99

productName.description: Product name or description. Example: 'cotton t-shirt', 'laptop computer', 'running shoes'

name: classify_product
